title: The Train Ticket
answer: C, the guest. He said his train arrived at midnight, but his ticket was stamped 10:45 PM, so he was already there at 11:15.

beats.line: Mr. Price was found dead at his country house. His watch had stopped at exactly 11:15.
Whoever did it was in the house at 11:15.
The driver says he was fixing the car in the garage all night.
The cook says she was baking bread from ten until midnight.
The guest says his train didn't get in until midnight.

visual.name: The Guest
visual.alibi: My train got in at midnight.

beats.line: Clue one: the garage camera. The light was on all night.
Clue two: the oven timer. Set at 10:05, finished at 11:50.
Clue three: a train ticket in the guest room, stamped 10:45.
Only one alibi doesn't add up. Who's lying? A, B, or C?
Comment your answer. The solution is in the pinned comment.
